title: lathyrus japonicus f. pubescens
intro: Lathyrus japonicus f. pubescens, commonly known as Japanese hairy pea or hairy pea vetch, is a flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, which may contribute to the prevention of cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus japonicus f. pubescens are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may also help to protect against certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
